steps.eval: (() => { const empty = document.querySelector('[data-sidebar-groups-empty]'); if (!empty) throw new Error('没有分组时缺少空状态块'); const text = empty.innerText.trim(); if (!text.includes('新建分组')) throw new Error('空状态缺少「新建分组」按钮文案: ' + text); if (text.length < 10) throw new Error('空状态只有一行灰字，没有引导: ' + text); const btn = [...empty.querySelectorAll('button')].find((el) => el.getAttribute('aria-label') === '新建分组'); if (!btn) throw new Error('空状态按钮缺少 aria-label'); const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect(); if (rect.height < 24) throw new Error('空状态按钮热区不足 24px: ' + rect.height); return { text, buttonHeight: Math.round(rect.height), groups: document.querySelectorAll('[data-sidebar-group]').length }; })()

(() => { const dialog = document.querySelector('[role=dialog]'); if (!dialog) throw new Error('点「新建分组」没有打开弹窗'); if (!(dialog.innerText || '').includes('分组名称')) throw new Error('弹窗内容不对: ' + dialog.innerText.slice(0, 40)); return 'dialog-open'; })()
